title: Cover the delegation worktree link fence with a Windows junction test
outcome: The lease and reservation fence through a link into a delegation worktree is exercised on Windows (junction), not only on Unix (symlink).
acceptance: A cfg(windows) test creates a junction into an ended delegation's worktree and shows that creation through it is refused while the worktree is reserved, and that a lease through it keeps the worktree from being reserved.
